options.backup: Backup: store project data in the backup folder

screenshotLimit.title: Screenshot History Limit
screenshotLimit.description: Limit the number of files in the screenshot history folder. Once exceeded, the oldest files will be automatically deleted (default is 200).

reset.title: Reset settings
reset.description: Reset all settings to their defaults.
reset.label: Reset
reset.confirmMessage: Reset all settings to their defaults? This action cannot be undone.
reset.message: All settings have been reset to their defaults.

settings.openFolderUnsupported: This client cannot open the plugin data folder.

saveCompressionSpeed.title: Save compression speed
saveCompressionSpeed.description: Fast by default. Controls PNG / WebP encoding effort when saving edits and screenshots. Export dimensions, quality settings and editable data are preserved; fast mode may produce larger files. Batch and paste compression still use balanced mode.

enableImageCompression.title: Compress images when saving
enableImageCompression.description: Automatically compress edited images when saving. When WebP conversion is enabled below, PNG and JPG/JPEG images are saved as WebP.

convertToWebP.title: Convert PNG/JPG to WebP
convertToWebP.description: Try converting PNG and JPG/JPEG to WebP. Manual and paste/drop compression use WebP only when it is smaller; otherwise the original file is kept. Edited images are saved as WebP with project data in XMP metadata.

webpQuality.title: WebP quality
webpQuality.description: Default: 100 (lossless). Lower values use lossy compression and may darken or dull saturated colors such as orange. Applies only to WebP conversion or compression.

pngCompressionMode.title: PNG compression mode
pngCompressionMode.description: Lossless compression uses Oxipng to preserve the original 32-bit image quality. Lossy compression reduces file size through palette quantization.

pngQuality.title: PNG lossy quality
pngQuality.description: Default: 92. Applies only to lossy PNG compression. Controls the number of palette colors; lower values produce smaller files.

jpegQuality.title: JPG/JPEG quality
jpegQuality.description: Default: 92. Controls the quality when re-encoding JPG/JPEG images.

enablePasteImageCompression.title: Compress pasted images
enablePasteImageCompression.description: Insert pasted or dropped PNG, JPG/JPEG and WebP images first, then compress them in the background. Use only smaller results. Same-format compression preserves the filename and link; WebP conversion changes only the extension and updates the link. Keep the original on failure. Disabled by default.

showPasteImageCompressionNotification.title: Show paste compression notifications
showPasteImageCompressionNotification.description: Show file size changes after compressing pasted or dropped images. Disable to compress silently. Enabled by default; failures are always reported.

compressAllAssets.title: Compress all asset images
compressAllAssets.description: Compress PNG, JPG/JPEG and WebP images in data/assets in the background. Close settings and keep editing notes. Preserve formats, filenames, note references and project data. Skip unchanged images already processed with the same settings.
compressAllAssets.label: Compress all images
compressAllAssets.confirmMessage: Overwrite compressible images in data/assets using the current PNG, JPG/JPEG and WebP settings. Formats and filenames are preserved to keep note references valid. Continue?
compressAllAssets.backgroundStarted: Asset compression is running in the background. Close settings and keep editing notes; progress appears in the status bar.
compressAllAssets.alreadyRunning: Asset compression is already running in the background.
compressAllAssets.unsupported: This plugin instance does not support batch compression.
compressAllAssets.empty: No compressible PNG, JPG/JPEG or WebP images found in assets.
compressAllAssets.summary: Asset compression complete: ${compressed} compressed, ${remembered} previously processed, ${notSmaller} kept unchanged, ${sourceChanged} skipped after file changes, ${failed} failed${savedText}

enableScreenshot.title: Enable screenshots
enableScreenshot.description: When disabled, screenshot shortcuts and the top bar screenshot button are unavailable. Disabled by default.

tidyBackup.title: Clean up backup folder
tidyBackup.description: Check backup files and remove those without a matching image in assets (after removing the .json suffix).
tidyBackup.label: Clean up backups
tidyBackup.confirmMessage: Clean up the backup folder? Backups without matching assets will be permanently deleted.
tidyBackup.success: Backup cleanup complete: removed ${count} files without matching assets.

clearBackup.title: Empty backup folder
clearBackup.description: Permanently delete all files in data/storage/petal/siyuan-plugin-imgReEditor/backup. Images saved in backup mode can no longer be re-edited with their original project data.
clearBackup.label: Empty backups
clearBackup.confirmMessage: Empty the backup folder? This action cannot be undone.
